title: Cosmic Mouse and Green Dog
description: A robed mouse with pink patterned skirt stands on a lily pad in swirling blue water, hands clasped, gazing upward. A large green dog with red eyes, gold chain, and blood on its mouth rests its paw on a crystal ball showing a smaller green dog and a blue hooded figure, all beneath a massive swirling cosmic portal with yin-yang symbols and light beams.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a brown mouse in a hooded brown robe and pink patterned skirt standing on a lily pad in swirling water, looking up at a giant swirling cosmic portal filled with stars, yin-yang symbols and spirals. To the right, a large emerald green dog with red eyes, gold chain collar, and blood dripping from its mouth rests its paw on a crystal ball containing miniature versions of a green dog and a blue robed figure. The scene includes hanging potions, coral, labeled drawers, and dramatic light beams from the vortex.
